name: Button
description: Action control for deliberate commands. Emphasis controls hierarchy, tone distinguishes default from critical intent, and loading is a public semantic state; browser interaction states remain derived.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible button label/content and primary accessible-name source.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic action tone. Critical is reserved for destructive or high-risk commands.

props.name: loading
props.description: Marks an unresolved action while preserving focus and preventing duplicate activation.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Logical placement of optional icon relative to label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native unavailable state using the HTML disabled attribute.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native button element and visual container.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible action label and accessible-name owner.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional decorative icon rendered at logical leading or trailing position.

anatomy.name: busy-indicator
anatomy.description: Static loading glyph shown only for the public loading state.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover rendered with CSS; not a public state prop.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Active pointer/keyboard visual rendered with CSS; not a public state prop.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator derived from browser focus-visible state.

states.name: loading
states.description: Public unresolved-action state that remains focusable and suppresses duplicate activation.

semantics.accessibleName: Visible children provide the normal name; loadingLabel provides the loading name; decorative icons never own the name.
requirements: Default type is button when consumer omits type.
Native disabled uses the disabled attribute.
Loading sets aria-busy=true and aria-disabled=true while remaining focusable.
Loading suppresses duplicate activation without switching to native disabled styling.
Normal and loading content both participate in intrinsic width so the button does not shrink or jump between labels.

icon.description: Optional decorative icon content; presence derives the Figma showIcon representation.
